## Navimower Map Card 0.3.4-beta8

### Settings dialog
- Replace the custom HTML switch/select/slider/time controls with Home Assistant's own Lovelace entity-row frontend components via `loadCardHelpers().createRowElement()`.
- Keep the configured Settings entity list, but let Home Assistant choose the correct native row/control for each entity domain, including toggles, selects, number sliders, time inputs and read-only entities.
- Fix the stacked Settings-dialog regression introduced in beta6: the Settings gear is intercepted before the older beta5/beta6 handlers, so only one Settings dialog opens.
- Closing Settings now clears both legacy Settings flags and returns directly to the Map Card instead of revealing the old read-only dialog underneath.
- Keep a More Info fallback if Home Assistant row helpers are unexpectedly unavailable.
